svg.title: After layer 9, Quill reads Ember’s tokens at its token “you” and adds the result
svg.desc: One read through the link after one exchange layer, as in pairing/link.py Side.show and Side.read: Quill's token "you" (time 3) attends over every Ember token read at time 3 or earlier plus its null key. Purple parts belong to the reader (Quill), orange parts to the sender (Ember). Bars, gate meters and weights are drawings, not measured values.

text.tspan: After layer 9, Quill reads Ember’s tokens at its token “you” and adds the result
